enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down slightly. Remain still. Sleep.

Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Comb hair. Put on clothes. Walk to kitchen.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Put eggs on plate. Pick up fork. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate and fork. Rinse plate and fork. Place in dishwasher.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirrors. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Review notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record results. Administer medication. Walk to next patient. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose sandwich. Pick up apple. Pick up bottle of water. Pay cashier. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Eat apple. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw trash. Return tray. Walk out of cafeteria. Walk to break room.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Place chicken in pan. Cook chicken. Add vegetables. Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Lean back. Watch TV. Change channel. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Continue watching TV.

Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Type password. Open browser. Read emails. Type reply. Send email. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Watch video. Close browser. Shut down laptop. Stand up. Walk to couch. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Walk to bedroom. Set alarm on phone. Plug phone into charger. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
